title: Bill Skarsgård Leads Action in PHYSINT at Tokyo Game Show
seoTitle: Bill Skarsgård Leads PHYSINT Action at Tokyo Game Show
subtitle: Swedish Actor Takes Lead Role in Kojima Productions' Espionage Game
excerpt: During the Tokyo Game Show 2026 broadcast, Hideo Kojima revealed that Bill Skarsgård will star in PHYSINT, an action-espionage game to be published by Xbox.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
During the Tokyo Game Show 2026 broadcast, Hideo Kojima announced that Bill Skarsgård will star in PHYSINT, Kojima Productions' new action-espionage game. The revelation came with an official poster showing the actor alongside Charlee Fraser.

Bill Skarsgård Confirmed as PHYSINT Protagonist

Kojima Productions founder Hideo Kojima stated in an official announcement that the Swedish actor will take on the main role in PHYSINT. He emphasized the mutual admiration between the parties and the confidence generated by costume, scanning, and camera tests conducted earlier this year.

Official Poster Reveals Partnership with Charlee Fraser

The poster released by Kojima features a photograph taken by the director himself, in which Skarsgård appears alongside Charlee Fraser. The image offers a first glimpse into the project's aesthetics and indicates Fraser's presence in the cast.

Xbox Publishes PHYSINT and Expands Collaboration with Kojima Productions

Xbox announced that it will publish PHYSINT, reinforcing a partnership that already includes the title OD – KNOCK. The collaboration also extends to film and television projects, broadening the reach of stories developed by both companies.

Cast and Next Steps in Development

In addition to Skarsgård and Fraser, PHYSINT's cast will include Don Lee and Minami Hamabe. Kojima promised further casting updates throughout development. The announcement also featured behind-the-scenes images of OD – KNOCK, with Sophia Lillis and Hunter Schafer in performance capture.

Context of Bill Skarsgård's Career

Recently, Skarsgård received praise for his performance in Dead Man’s Wire (2026) and has upcoming projects such as The Mosquito Bowl, Lords of War, and The Death of Robin Hood. He is internationally known for his role as Pennywise in the adaptations of It (2017 and 2019).

With information from XBOX Wire.
